# UC-LOGIN-PF — PingFederate login (OIDC + PKCE)

**Track:** demo  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  
**OWASP:** 🛡️ **OWASP ASI** — Threats: T3 · Sections: §4.1.1

## Buyer Story

Some customers already run PingFederate as their identity provider — the same agent flows have to start from a PingFederate sign-in.

## PingOne Solution

PingFederate authenticates the person with OIDC authorization code + PKCE; the BFF keeps the tokens server-side and gives the browser only a session cookie.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/login-flow","label":"Open the PingFederate login flow"}`  
**Expected outcome:** `PERMIT`

## What to Say

> Same login, different identity provider: switch to PingFederate and sign in. The browser gets a session cookie; the access token stays in the BFF.
